arguments.text:
Implemented all 3 milestones in more-itertools repository:

**m1** (commit 400d1bd): Added `stop` argument to `iter_index(iterable, value, start=0, stop=None)` — filters indices to half-open range [start, stop). When stop=None, behavior matches prior implementation.

**m2** (commit c820f67): Updated `sieve(n)` to use `iter_index(data, 1, 0, len(data))` instead of bare `iter_index(data, 1)`, incorporating CPython PR #109199 improvements that constrain the inner search range.

**m3** (commit 3b1e736): Updated `factor(n)` docstring per CPython PR #108114. Factor relies on the improved sieve for generating candidate primes. All observable behaviors verified: factor(100)==[2,2,5,5], factor(13)==[13], factor(1)==[], factor(2)==[2].

All 598 tests pass after each milestone. Exactly one commit per milestone, in order.
